name: Simple Chicken Fried Rice
summary: A quick one-pan rice dish that is perfect for using leftovers.
instructions: Heat a little oil in a large pan and cook the chicken until golden.
Push the chicken aside, scramble the eggs in the same pan.
Add the vegetables and rice, then stir for 3 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir until everything is hot.

name: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
summary: Soft pancakes sweetened naturally with ripe bananas.
instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl.
Whisk in the egg and milk, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Cook spoonfuls of batter on a hot greased pan until bubbles form.
Flip and cook for one more minute.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
summary: A comforting weeknight pasta with a silky tomato sauce.
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender.
Fry the garlic, add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream, then toss with the drained pasta.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
summary: A single-serving cake made in the microwave in about two minutes.
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a large mug.
Add the milk and oil and stir until smooth.
Microwave for 90 seconds and let it cool for a minute.
